description: Source code for a gettext localization library, defining the _Locale class and its methods for managing translations, languages, and message files.

classes.name: _Locale
classes.description: A class managing localization, translation mappings, and message file loading.

methods.name: newLocale
methods.description: Creates a new _Locale instance with specified domain, path, and optional data.

methods.name: makeTrMapKey
methods.description: Generates a key for translation map based on domain and locale.

methods.name: FileSystem
methods.description: Returns the associated FileSystem object.

methods.name: GetLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the current language setting.

methods.name: SetLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language and updates translation mappings.

methods.name: GetDomain
methods.description: Retrieves the current domain.

methods.name: SetDomain
methods.description: Sets the domain and updates translation mappings.

methods.name: syncTrMap
methods.description: Synchronizes the translation map with available message files.

methods.name: Gettext
methods.description: Retrieves the translated string for a message ID.

methods.name: PGettext
methods.description: Retrieves the translated string with context.

methods.name: NGettext
methods.description: Retrieves the plural form translation based on count.

methods.name: PNGettext
methods.description: Retrieves the plural form translation with context.

methods.name: DGettext
methods.description: Retrieves translation for a specific domain.

methods.name: DNGettext
methods.description: Retrieves plural translation for a specific domain.

methods.name: DPGettext
methods.description: Retrieves contextual translation for a specific domain.

methods.name: DPNGettext
methods.description: Retrieves plural contextual translation for a specific domain.

methods.name: Getdata
methods.description: Loads resource data by name for current domain.

methods.name: DGetdata
methods.description: Loads resource data by name for specified domain.

methods.name: gettext
methods.description: Internal method to get translation for given parameters.

methods.name: getdata
methods.description: Internal method to load resource data for given domain and name.
